about: merge's decision table (the P3 procedure). Three surfaces of one gateway, each a turn the World's scenario scripts once (openaiWire.scenario, the Messages surface read by anthropicWire's reader), else the labeled stub: THE TWIN RUNS NO MODEL. Each call is priced from the twin's catalogue, refused when its provider is gated for the organization, and drawn from the organization's credit; the catalogue is listed as the organization may route to it. Every other operation is unmodeled.

decisions.demand: Open Autonomy's OpenAI chat completions (and through its rail RH2's, Volter Harness's and Substrate's workers); Volter Editor's Pi in Substrate on Claude Haiku 4.5
decisions.why: an action: a turn on the kernel's OpenAI wire, usage with cost and service_tier, routing when asked, a gated provider refused (403 vendor_access_required) to an organization without access, the credit drawn
an action: a turn in Gateway's native Responses shape (response.stream snapshots and response.done when streamed), usage with cost, the credit drawn
an action: a turn on the kernel's Messages wire, usage with no cost, routing on message_delta and message_stop when asked, the credit drawn

decisions.demand: Open Autonomy's /v1/catalog (and the kit's setup agent through the valve in RH2, Volter Harness and Substrate)
decisions.why: a stateless lookup: the twin's catalogue (no stored resource), filtered by provider and vendor, paged by cursor, each model's access_required as the organization's provider access says

decisions.demand: Open Autonomy's key and Volter Editor's page key
decisions.why: an organization, its prepaid credit and its API key are made in Gateway's dashboard, not through the API

decisions.demand: Volter Editor's Pi on Claude Haiku 4.5 from an organization made after Anthropic's cutoff
decisions.why: a gated provider is granted by Merge's support (in-app chat or support@merge.dev), not through the API
